info.what: The app or browser a person uses to talk to your system.
info.why: Every interaction starts here: opening a page, tapping a button or sending a message becomes a request to your servers.
info.analogy: A customer walking up to a shop counter.

samples.caption: The request a browser sends to open an order
samples.code:
GET /orders/101 HTTP/1.1
Host: shop.example.com
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGci…
